{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOVQjccM8AAAABZj2Czg", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bn3IfzhDKiD8", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bn3If", "number": 75, "title": "Correct V30MZ Jcc and JCXZ taken-target timing", "body": "## Problem

At baseline `39e0c125cd058c13dca088d605f40b5cf99be68f`, `crates/ws-core/src/cpu.rs` charges all taken Jcc instructions (`70–7F`) and JCXZ (`E3`) identically for even and odd destinations. Taken odd destinations therefore advance shared devices one clock too little, distorting polling, raster, timer and audio budgets. Commercial-title impact remains unmeasured.

Existing preservation assertions in `cpu/jmp_tests.rs` and `cpu/loop_tests.rs` explicitly retain this omission.

## Expected outcome

Apply the taken odd-destination adjustment to every Jcc condition and JCXZ within the existing serialized accounting. Preserve branch decisions, architectural state and actual fetch/wait charges. Include necessary native/browser coverage and correction of affected timing oracles.

Keep CALL, indirect JMP, full prefetch, other instruction costs and external-bus policy separate.

## Context

The checkout is clean and matches inspected remote `main`. No Issues or PRs are open; all 74 closed entry titles were checked. [Issue #73](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/issues/73) and [PR #74](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/pull/74) explicitly deferred Jcc/JCXZ.

The [NEC V30MZ manual](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/lbr/v30mztm-hardware-preliminary), Appendix A conditions/Note 5 and Table A-1, printed pp. 73–76, specifies four decoded clocks when these branches are taken, one otherwise, and an additional clock for an odd branch destination. With the repository’s two explicit internal byte fetches, inferred unprefixed totals are **6 clocks taken-even, 7 taken-odd, and 3 fallthrough**. Opcode parity alone adds nothing. These are serialized emulator expectations, not console measurements.

Correction record: the old AI-authored assumption preserved six-clock taken odd-target Jcc/JCXZ totals. Replace it with seven clocks under the stated internal-fetch conditions, retaining six for taken-even and three for fallthrough. The primary manual establishes the missing destination adjustment. Update affected preservation assertions without weakening architectural or regression acceptance. Further evidence-backed corrections must record the old assumption, replacement, source and rationale; they require no human approval or independent AI re-review.

The inspected [WSTimingTest report](https://github.com/FluBBaOfWard/WSTimingTest/blob/025e606fc3b6615160ffdae485d992ffcad0c024/README.md) corroborates branch-alignment effects on WonderSwan Color while identifying aggregate harness/pipeline uncertainty. Its opcode-pattern workaround is unsuitable.

Static inspection of committed `irq-timing.ws` finds handler bytes `43 4E 75 04 B0 80 E6 B6 CF` at RAM `200F`; JNZ targets odd `2017` on 1,023 iterations. With bytes unchanged, add 1,023 clocks: **61,459/67,603 → 62,482/68,626**, requiring **244–245/268–269** HBlank ticks. The former IRQ-entry charge would instead yield **184–185/208–209** ticks. These are calculated expectations, not observed results. Existing JMP and LOOP measured Jcc loop targets are even; their absolute budgets remain unchanged with the current bytes.

[Saved #73 validation](https://github.com/takahirox/wonderswan-rust/blob/39e0c125cd058c13dca088d605f40b5cf99be68f/docs/issue-73-validation.md) reports 248 workspace tests, complete production Chromium suites and criterion-level review passing. Tests present and reported execution are separate evidence; this planning investigation ran no application builds or tests.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Record independent literal timing/state vectors before changing execution costs. Implement the adjustment only for taken odd destinations across `70–7F` and `E3`. Charge actual opcode/displacement/prefix fetches and waits once; perform no destination pre-read or fetch-consolidation change.
- [ ] Add native vectors for all 16 Jcc conditions using independent truth expectations across CF/PF/ZF/SF/OF combinations. Cover JCXZ with CX `0000/0001/0002/FFFF` and contrasting flags. Exercise taken/fallthrough, both opcode and destination parities, zero/forward/backward displacements, signed displacement extremes, IP/displacement-fetch wrapping and 20-bit fetch wrapping. Assert exact CS/IP, unchanged CX for JCXZ, preserved full FLAGS, other registers, stack and memory. Expectations must not call production condition/timing helpers.
- [ ] Cover accessible internal RAM and mapped ROM banks with live A0 settings `00/04/08/0C`, including bank-boundary fetches. Retain segment/BUSLOCK behavior through seven prefixes and existing REP rejection. Correct the obsolete Jcc/JCXZ preservation literals in JMP/LOOP tests; preserve their remaining scope and checks.
- [ ] Exercise emulated Mono/Color/SwanCrystal model configurations: Mono mode `00`; Color and SwanCrystal modes `00/80/C0/E0`, including live transitions back to `00`. Through normal `Machine::run_frame`, demonstrate exact raster/frame, timer and audio advancement for representative Jcc and JCXZ paths, without executing an extra destination instruction. Preserve IRQ/TF priority, shadows, saved continuation/IRET, REP/HALT and separate GDMA/SDMA reservations and capability gates.
- [ ] Add a source-included original CC0 cartridge using repository fixture tooling, with independent native and production Chromium consumers. Measure absolute timing for Jcc and JCXZ taken-even, taken-odd and fallthrough paths; check CPU-written execution/destination counts, CX and continuation markers across supported configurations and fresh restart. Invalidate stale saved completion. Document every measured instruction, overhead and timer quantization. Record actual old-implementation failures in both consumers and corrected passes; relative parity differences alone are insufficient.
- [ ] Independently recalculate affected existing consumers and timing documentation. For unchanged IRQ bytes, use the calculated budgets above in native/browser consumers; preserve 32/35-clock internal IRQ entry, results `1024/0/0`, restart/stale-save checks and actual rejection of the former IRQ-entry charge. Preserve JMP and LOOP absolute timing/count/CX/continuation checks. Document any justified layout change and recalculate its oracle; never widen tolerances to absorb failures or rewrite historical observations.
- [ ] Preserve three-model behavior, firmware-free startup, LCD/input/frame continuity, audio/PCM, GDMA/SDMA/Hyper Voice, SRAM/cartridge/internal EEPROM and RTC retention, browser save integrity, local data handling and ownership/provenance. Coordinator runs `python3 fixtures/build.py --check`, `python3 demo/build.py --check`, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo test --workspace --locked`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `git diff --check`. In `web`, run `npm run build:wasm`, `npm run build`, then complete `npm run test:browser` and `npm run test:compat` sequentially with `WS_PREVIEW_URL` targeting an explicit local production preview.
- [ ] Update timing documentation, fixture provenance and validation evidence with source/artifact identities, independent calculations, actual observations, failures, corrections and unperformed checks. Coordinator reviews the final diff and evidence against every criterion and resolves blocking findings before merge. Mandatory acceptance uses automated native/browser tooling and introduces no human or console prerequisite.

## Optional validation

Additional lawful software experiments, another browser engine, console measurements and human gameplay may provide supplementary evidence. None was performed during planning; none blocks completion. Commercial-game compatibility and complete console pipeline timing remain unestablished.

## Required post-merge verification

None.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WonderSwan-family hardware goal.
Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance criteria when primary hardware
specifications establish the correction. Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.

This autonomous campaign has no human-approval gate. Mandatory acceptance uses
automated native and production-browser tests on the emulator's supported model
and mode configurations. Physical-console measurements and human gameplay are
optional evidence and must remain explicitly unperformed unless actually available.
Do not invent device identities, real-device results or a requirement for human
confirmation. Resolve technical errors with recorded evidence and automated checks
through the existing Coordinator workflow.
